note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

jsonic.reason: Go: no non-test .go file under go/ imports github.com/tabnas/jsonic/go. go/feed.go takes the engine's types from github.com/tabnas/parser/go (tabnas/feed#74), and the C library go/clib/core.go, stamped from admin's clib template, builds its host parser on the engine (`host.Make()` with host github.com/tabnas/parser/go) since admin's rollout moved feed's host from jsonic to the engine on 2026-10-06: a probe found the two hosts' results identical on all 4,037 inputs of test/ (the five that differ also differ between two jsonic-hosted parsers, because feed's XHTML serialization orders attributes by Go map iteration). go/go.mod still requires jsonic, for the tests. Rust: rs/src/lib.rs calls `tabnas_jsonic::make()` in `make_with`, which `make` and `parse` build on, so the crate hands out a ready feed parser. TypeScript: ts/src/feed.ts has no import of @tabnas/jsonic, value or type, and its only value exports are `VERSION`, `Feed` and `detect`, so it has no parser constructor and the caller writes `new Tabnas().use(jsonic).use(Feed)`, as the tests in ts/test do with jsonic as a devDependency; the peer was removed from ts/package.json on 2026-10-04 (tabnas/feed#71), and jsonic still reaches an install as a required peer of @tabnas/xml.
jsonic.repair: To agree on not having it: rs/src/lib.rs would build `make_with` on the engine (`tabnas::Tabnas`) instead of `tabnas_jsonic::make()`, as Go's C library now does. To agree on having it: ts/package.json would list @tabnas/jsonic as a peer again, reversing tabnas/feed#71, although ts/src would still not import it unless it gained a constructor like Rust's `make`, and the Go port would import jsonic for nothing it uses. jsonic stays in every port's build regardless while xml depends on it in TypeScript and Rust. The TypeScript peer was removed under ruling 9 of the handover page in tabnas/parser (doc/handover/README.md); nothing there rules on the Rust port. Undecided: awaits the maintainer's ruling.
